Text.Text: The range can teach a sounder discipline. Keep your center without forgetting the people around you. You've finished my Unmoving Center trials. I have no further work for you here.
The canyon trials require rank 50 in Staff. Reach that rank, then return. Stillness needs practice as much as movement does.

A crew at the canyon range is teaching poor staff work in the name of stillness. Bring back their tally so I can begin correcting it. Defeat six Unmoving Center Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina. I'll give you the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Unmoving Center.

Here's the Anchorhead Canyon Range Key. Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Unmoving Center Adepts, then return with the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally.

The staff doesn't move. Everything moves around it. That's the whole trick: find the point that doesn't have to go anywhere, and let the fight orbit it. Most people spend years hunting motion. I'm done hunting.

Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Unmoving Center Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
Adepts, mostly. They still lean on their weight when they swing. You'll feel the wrongness in it before you see it.
Defeat six Unmoving Center Adepts in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
You've defeated six Unmoving Center Adepts. Let me see the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists control the range's sightline calibrator. Take it back before they train more students around it. Defeat five Unmoving Center Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat five Unmoving Center Specialists to secure the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator, then return to me.
Rigidity isn't stillness. Rigid things shatter first. These specialists hold a pose and call it mastery. I've watched three of them crack under a first real hit. That's what you're going to test.

Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Unmoving Center Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
Better footwork than the adepts, worse instincts. They've drilled the shapes long enough to look convincing at a glance.
Defeat five Unmoving Center Specialists in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
You've defeated five Unmoving Center Specialists. Let me see the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the deeper range. Recover her crest and end that defense. Defeat the Unmoving Center Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unmoving Center Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Unmoving Center Shattered Range Crest.

It demands you stop flinching before the hit lands, not after. The warden never flinches. That's not a boast. I've watched her take a hit that should have ended her and just kept standing. That's the discipline working, or it's something else wearing the discipline's face.
In Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unmoving Center Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Unmoving Center Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Unmoving Center Warden in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Shattered Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Unmoving Center Warden. Let me see the Unmoving Center Shattered Range Crest.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four instructors still control the range's challenge chit. Take it so we can challenge their master. Defeat four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
Your key still grants access to Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Defeat four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle to secure the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

It demands you let go of the circle they've built around each other. Four of them stand back to back and call that unity. It's just four people afraid to be still alone. I never needed the other three.

Use 'Anchorhead Canyon Range' in Tatooine, Anchorhead, North Entrance. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Unmoving Center Inner Circle fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle in Tatooine, Anchorhead Canyon Range. Their defeat secures the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina.
You've defeated four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle. Let me see the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master has answered the challenge. Defeat her in the Canyon Dueling Pit to finish the trials. Defeat the Unmoving Center Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unmoving Center Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

It demands you understand what I'm asking you to end. She found the center and never left it. That's not victory, whatever it looks like from outside. I want you to stop her before stillness finishes swallowing her the rest of the way, or before she does the same to you.
In Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Unmoving Center Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Everything you're learning to do, she already does without trying. That's what I'm sending you to stand against, and why I'm telling you plainly: don't stand against it alone. Bring two you'd trust with your back. She's earned every one of the people who didn't.

Defeat the Unmoving Center Master in Tatooine, Canyon Dueling Pit. Report back to me here in Tatooine, Anchorhead, Cantina; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Unmoving Center Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The range can teach a sounder discipline. Keep your center without forgetting the people around you. You've earned the right to train Unmoving Center. Your final payment is ready.
Anyway, the job.
I'll defeat six Unmoving Center Adepts.
What's this stillness supposed to be, exactly?
Where do I find them?
What am I walking into?
Not yet.
Here's the Unmoving Center Canyon Range Tally.
Anyway, the job.
I'll defeat five Unmoving Center Specialists.
What makes them different from the adepts?
Same range?
What should I watch for this time?
I need a moment.
Here's the Unmoving Center Sightline Calibrator.
Back to it.
I'll defeat the Unmoving Center Warden.
What's different about the warden?
Where do I find her?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Give me time to find the right two.
Here's the Unmoving Center Shattered Range Crest.
Back to it.
I'll defeat four members of the Unmoving Center Inner Circle.
Who are they to you?
Where's their floor?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Let me find four I trust first.
Here's the Unmoving Center Marshal's Challenge Chit.
Back to it.
I'll face the Unmoving Center Master and report back.
What am I actually ending?
Where does she wait?
What is she going to do?
I need to find two people who'd walk in there with me.
The Unmoving Center Master is defeated. Here's my report.
